items.exampleEn: The highway is busy on Friday evenings.
items.exampleZh: 星期五傍晚公路上車很多。

items.exampleEn: This hotel is popular with young travelers.
items.exampleZh: 這家旅館很受年輕旅客歡迎。

items.exampleEn: Turn right into the small lane.
Can you call a cab for me?
items.exampleZh: 你可以幫我叫一台計程車嗎？

items.exampleEn: My parents went on a cruise to Japan.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽搭郵輪去日本旅遊。

items.exampleEn: Check your brakes before a long ride.
items.exampleZh: 長途騎車前先檢查煞車。

items.exampleEn: I paid the fare with my card.
I put my name on my suitcase.
items.exampleZh: 我把名字寫在行李箱上。

items.sentenceEn: The cab fare was very high.

items.audioEn: Our cruise leaves on Friday and comes back the next Thursday.
items.audioZh: 我們的郵輪星期五出發，下週四回來。

items.sentenceEn: Many travelers come here in summer.
items.sentenceZh: 很多旅客夏天會來這裡。

items.sentenceEn: Stay in the right lane on the highway.
items.sentenceZh: 在公路上請走右側車道。

items.stemEn: I can't stop my bike! The ____ are broken.
items.stemZh: 我的腳踏車停不下來！煞車壞了。

items.stemEn: How much is the bus ____ to the airport?
items.stemZh: 到機場的公車票價是多少？

items.passageEn: Last month, David took a trip with his family. First, they drove on the highway for three hours. Then the car's brakes stopped working, so they left the car at a garage and took a cab to the station. The cab fare was expensive, and David's suitcase was very heavy. "Next time, let's go on a cruise and relax!" his wife said.
items.passageZh: 上個月，David 和家人去旅行。他們先在公路上開了三個小時的車。後來車子的煞車失靈了，所以他們把車留在修車廠，搭計程車去車站。計程車資很貴，David 的行李箱又很重。他太太說：「下次我們去搭郵輪放鬆一下吧！」

questions.questionZh: David 的太太下次想怎麼旅行？

rubricZh: 「迷路了」可寫例如 is lost、got lost

items.promptZh: 這個行李箱裝不下我所有的衣服。
referenceEn: This suitcase can't hold all my clothes.
I can't fit all my clothes in this suitcase.
rubricZh: 用 suitcase 表示「行李箱」
「裝不下」可寫，例如 can't hold、can't fit…in 等
